signal: HSI unveiled Sky, an AI assistant for workplace safety, and acquired HandsHQ

email.body1:
Nancy, saw HSI unveiled Sky, your new AI assistant for workplace safety, on the heels of the HandsHQ acquisition.

Launching new offerings usually means more accounts for your inside sales team to cover than the day allows, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nancy, quick follow-up for HSI.

As the product line and client base grow through acquisition, the pipeline target outpaces what inside sales can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter from behind is brutal.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nancy, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your inside sales motion? I'll tailor it to HSI either way.
